steps.say: Peyronie disease is an acquired disorder of the tunica albuginea. Microvascular trauma is followed by faulty healing. A fibroproliferative plaque is formed instead of elastic tissue. Penile curvature is produced by the scarred segment. Genetically susceptible men are affected most often. Repeated buckling is recognised as the trigger.
steps.tx: **Peyronie disease** (bent penis disease) is an acquired **fibroproliferative plaque** (scar pad) disorder of the **tunica albuginea** (stiff erection sheath) after microvascular trauma in susceptible men. Repeated buckling injures the tunic and heals with collagen excess, because faulty remodelling replaces elastic fibres with scar.

steps.say: The active phase is marked by painful evolving curvature. Erection pain is reported with a soft palpable plaque. The deformity is observed shifting over months. Stability beyond 3 to 6 months is awaited patiently. The stable phase is declared when pain resolves. A firm calcified plaque is felt at examination.
steps.tx: The **active phase** (painful evolving stage) brings erection pain, shifting curvature, and a soft plaque, settling after **3 to 6 months** (three to six) into the **stable phase** (fixed painless stage) with a firm **calcified plaque** (chalky hard lump). Document curvature with photos at each visit, because operating on a moving target guarantees recurrence.

vis.alt: Penile lesions including Peyronie plaque with curvature.
vis.caption: Peyronie plaque with curvature: operate only once the stable phase arrives. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Collagenase Clostridium histolyticum is injected into stable plaques. Xiaflex is the only licensed intralesional preparation. Curvatures between 30 and 90 degrees are selected. The plaque is needled and then modelled firmly by stretching. Enzymatic lysis is combined with careful mechanical remodelling. Repeat cycles are scheduled several weeks apart.
steps.tx: **Collagenase Clostridium histolyticum** (plaque dissolving enzyme, **Xiaflex** (enzyme injection)) is the sole licensed **intralesional injection** (shot into the plaque) for stable palpable plaques curving **30** to **90 degrees** (thirty to ninety). Inject into the plaque, then model the stretch a day later, because enzymatic lysis plus mechanical remodelling straightens best.

steps.say: Nesbit corporoplasty is performed by tucking the long side. Tunica albuginea plication is done with folding stitches. Both shortening procedures are reserved for curves under 60 degrees. Hourglass deformity is excluded carefully before plication. Modest length loss is disclosed honestly during counselling. Straightness is traded knowingly for length.
steps.tx: **Nesbit corporoplasty** (tuck stitch repair) and **tunica albuginea plication** (fold stitch repair) are **shortening procedure** (long side tuck) operations that tuck the convex long side for curves under **60 degrees** (sixty) without hourglass deformity. Counsel about modest length loss upfront, because shortening is the price of straightness.

steps.say: Plaque incision and grafting is offered for severe curvature. Curves over 60 degrees are treated by lengthening. Short penises and hourglass waists are included as indications. Normal erectile function is required beforehand for grafting. The defect is grafted rather than widely excised. Shaft stability is preserved by patch repair.
steps.tx: **Plaque incision and grafting** (cut and patch repair, **PIG** (lengthening patch)) opens the contracted concave side for severe curves over **60 degrees** (sixty), short penises, or hourglass waists in men with working erections. It is a **lengthening procedure** (short side release), so graft the defect rather than excising plaque, because excision destabilises the shaft.

vis.alt: Penile deformity patterns assessed before grafting surgery.
vis.caption: Severe curvature or hourglass deformity: grafting lengthens the short side. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Saphenous vein graft is harvested carefully from the leg. Fascia lata and buccal mucosa are used as alternatives. Porcine small intestinal submucosa is available off the shelf. Pericardial grafts are selected for large defects. Watertight suturing is performed to prevent leaks. Haematoma is avoided by meticulous layered haemostasis.
steps.tx: Patch choices for grafting span autologous **saphenous vein graft** (leg vein), fascia lata, and buccal mucosa, plus off the shelf **porcine small intestinal submucosa** (pig gut layer) and pericardium. Match graft stretch to defect size and suture watertight, because leaks haematoma.

steps.say: Penile prosthesis is implanted for concurrent erectile failure. Concurrent ED is confirmed by failed pill trials. Manual modelling is performed over the rigid cylinders. Plaque incision is added when modelling alone falls short. Residual curvature is corrected by touch up grafting. Rigidity is guaranteed regardless of residual plaque.
steps.tx: Implant a prosthesis with manual modelling or plaque incision for Peyronie with **concurrent ED** (simultaneous impotence), the **prosthesis with modeling** (implant plus stretch) strategy, when pills fail. Straighten over the rigid cylinders, because modelling needs a firm core. Counsel that cylinders fix rigidity while residual curve may need touch up grafting.

steps.say: The surgical contraindication active phase is respected strictly. No operation is performed while any pain persists. Shifting curvature is observed patiently until full stability. Serial photos are compared carefully across visits. Stability is declared only after months of stillness. Plication or grafting is chosen carefully only after that.
steps.tx: The **surgical contraindication active phase** (no knife while evolving) rule bars every operation while pain persists and curvature shifts. Wait for stability, then choose plication or grafting, because cutting active disease invites recurrence. Document stability with serial photos and examinations over months before listing.
